events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed reservation was completed and verified in two places. The confirmation (evidence #20) states 'Quarterly planning is booked at Willow' with a Confirmed label, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included and Reservation total $245 all charges included. My reservations (evidence #22) lists the same single Confirmed reservation: Quarterly planning, Willow, 12 people, Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, $245. The one-hour slot, purpose, capacity, projector and $350 budget limit are all satisfied.

Interpretação simulada: Gather provided a complete path from room listing through plan, room choice, meeting name and review to a confirmed, saved reservation that matches every declared requirement. The only notable friction was having to select Willow twice, which cost one extra step but did not affect the outcome or price.

Limites: The date is shown only as the relative label 'Tomorrow' with the 10:00–11:00 time, and the footer states this is a demo venue where reservations are saved only in this browser session. No real payment was taken and no external calendar invite was checked, so persistence outside this session is not established.

Capturas indicadas: #20, #22, #18, #10. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Willow meets the 12-person, projector and $350 requirements at $245 all-in
findings.observation: Willow was listed as 12 seats with Projector for a $245 total ($235 room + $0 projector + $10 service, 'nothing added later'), and the confirmation and My reservations list show Quarterly planning at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, for $245.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector and an all-in total at or below $350 for the available one-hour slot, with the purpose 'Quarterly planning'.
findings.expectedSource: The persona's explicit meeting requirements in the mission: 12 people, projector, one hour, purpose Quarterly planning, total at or below $350.
findings.personaComment: Willow fit all 12 of us with the projector and came to $245 — well inside my $350 allowance.
findings.interpretation: The product offers at least one room that satisfies all of this persona's hard constraints without needing a workaround or a budget exception, as shown by the completed and saved reservation.
findings.uncertainty: Only the Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot and the two rooms shown were explored; other dates, times and rooms were not checked.

findings.title: Review, confirmation and saved list consistently restate all booking details
findings.observation: The Review screen restated 'Quarterly planning', seating for 12 and a projector, and the confirmation card and My reservations entry repeat Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector/Included and $245 with a Confirmed label.
findings.expected: The review and final reservation should accurately restate the room, meeting purpose, people, projector and total so the persona can verify them before and after confirming.
findings.expectedSource: The persona's expectation of a clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details, plus the mission instruction to verify the final reservation details.
findings.personaComment: I could check the name, seats, projector and total on one review screen, and the saved reservation matches it exactly.
findings.interpretation: Restating every requirement at review and again on the confirmation and saved-reservations list makes verification quick and reduces the chance of confirming the wrong room or total.
findings.uncertainty: The reservation is shown as saved only in this browser session, as stated in the page footer, so persistence beyond the session was not verified.

findings.title: Room chosen on the landing page must be chosen again after the plan step
findings.observation: Clicking 'Choose Willow' on the landing page opened the 'What's the plan?' form instead of a Willow booking step, and after continuing, the same Atlas and Willow cards appeared and Willow had to be chosen a second time to reach the meeting-name step.
findings.expected: Choosing a named room would carry that room forward, or the initial button would make clear it only starts the planning steps.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the landing-page button label 'Choose Willow', which names a specific room rather than a general planning action.
findings.personaComment: I had already picked Willow, so choosing it again felt like a repeat — though the details were all still there.
findings.interpretation: The repeated room choice adds a small extra step and a moment of uncertainty about whether the first selection was kept, but it did not block completion because the same room and price were presented again.
findings.uncertainty: This is based on one pass through the flow; whether the initial button is intended only as an entry into the plan steps was not stated on screen.

finding.interpretation: Gather provided a complete path from room listing through plan, room choice, meeting name and review to a confirmed, saved reservation that matches every declared requirement. The only notable friction was having to select Willow twice, which cost one extra step but did not affect the outcome or price.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Two rooms are shown: Atlas $280 and Willow $245, both labelled 12 seats and Projector and available tomorrow, with itemised totals and 'nothing added later'.
experience.reaction: Willow fits all 12 of us, has the projector, and $245 leaves room in my budget — I'll take that one.

feedback.summary: Room cards list 12 seats, Projector and an all-in total up front, letting me choose a room within $350 without extra checking.
feedback.why: Willow shows $245 total with $235 room + $0 projector + $10 service and 'nothing added later', so it meets the 12-person, projector and budget requirements on the first screen.

experience.observation: A 'What's the plan?' form shows When Tomorrow, Time 10:00–11:00, People 12 people, and 'We need a projector' checked, with a 'See available rooms' button.
experience.reaction: The details already match — 12 people, projector, one hour — so I'll continue.

feedback.summary: Plan form already shows 12 people, a one-hour 10:00–11:00 slot and the projector checked, so I do not need to re-enter my requirements.
feedback.why: The visible defaults on this screen match the meeting size, duration and projector need, letting me proceed directly to available rooms.

experience.observation: The 'Find your kind of room' step summarises Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required, and lists Atlas $280 and Willow $245, both 12 seats with Projector and available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Same rooms again — I'll pick Willow once more and carry on.

feedback.summary: I have to choose Willow a second time after already selecting it on the landing page, adding a repeated step.
feedback.why: The room list at this step shows the same Atlas and Willow cards and Choose buttons, so my earlier selection was not carried through as the booked room.

experience.observation: A 'Your meeting' form has an empty Meeting name field with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning'; the Willow summary shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector included, and Total $245 all charges included.
experience.reaction: Total is confirmed at $245, well within budget — now for the meeting name.

feedback.summary: The side summary confirms Willow at $245 all-in for 12 people with the projector included before I enter the meeting name.
feedback.why: It lists Room $235, Projector $0 and Service $10 with Total $245 'All charges included', so I can verify the $350 limit is met before reviewing.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused and still shows the placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning'; the Willow $245 summary remains on the right.
experience.reaction: I'll add the meeting name now.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now contains 'Quarterly planning' and the Willow summary still shows Total $245 for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included.
experience.reaction: Name's in — I'll check the review before confirming.

experience.observation: The Review step shows Meeting name 'Quarterly planning', text stating the reservation includes a projector and seating for 12, and the Willow summary with Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 and Total $245 all charges included.
experience.reaction: Everything matches my requirements and budget, so I'll confirm it now.

feedback.summary: The review restates 'Quarterly planning', seating for 12, projector included and the $245 all-in total, letting me verify every requirement before confirming.
feedback.why: All mission checks are visible on one screen — Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included and Total $245 — so I can confirm without going back.

experience.observation: A confirmation page says 'You've got a room. Quarterly planning is booked at Willow', with a Confirmed label, People 12, Projector Included and Reservation total $245 all charges included.
experience.reaction: That's confirmed and within budget — I'll just verify it appears in my reservations.

feedback.summary: The confirmation card restates the meeting name, room, time, 12 people, projector and $245 total with a Confirmed label, so I can verify the booking at a glance.
feedback.why: Every mission requirement is visible on the confirmation: 'Quarterly planning' at Willow, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included and Reservation total $245, within the $350 limit.
